item: Row B4 the Hindi and Bengali tokenizer: the article index keeps combining marks inside a word, rebuilt in the migration's stopped window
summary: S05-02 S6, R39. article_fts is created with categories 'L* N* Co M*' so a Devanagari or Bengali word with a vowel sign is one token (it was shredded at every sign). The tokenizer cannot be altered, so an existing index is rebuilt: never at boot, inside migrate-countries' app-stopped window after the country flip (estimate printed first, 981 to 1,645 s per 130 GB scaled from ensure_fts's record), or by an explicit re-index. One savepoint holds drop, create and rebuild so a death leaves the old index; a failure after the flip leaves state fts-pending with the exception class only and the next run finishes it. fts_status reports the tokenizer.
